paper.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: 本文提出通过纯强化学习（RL）激励大语言模型的推理能力，无需人工标注的推理轨迹 [abstract]。作者基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 GRPO 框架，仅以最终答案正确性作为奖励信号，训练出 DeepSeek-R1-Zero，该模型自然涌现出自我反思、验证等推理模式 [S1.p2]。在 AIME 2024 上，DeepSeek-R1-Zero 的 pass@1 从 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，结合自洽解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。为解决可读性差和语言混杂问题，作者进一步提出多阶段训练的 DeepSeek-R1，在推理和通用任务上均取得提升 [S1.p3][S4.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习自我演化出推理能力，从而减少对人工标注推理轨迹的依赖 [S1.p2]。现有方法如思维链提示和基于人类演示的后训练，其性能受限于人类提供的范例，且难以探索非人类式的更优推理路径 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts.
Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases.

by constraining models to replicate human thought processes, their performance is inherently capped by the human-provided exemplars, which prevents the exploration of superior, non-human-like reasoning pathways.

method.text: 论文基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 作为强化学习框架，奖励信号仅基于最终预测与标准答案的正确性，不约束推理过程本身 [S1.p2]。训练中跳过了传统的监督微调阶段，以激励模型探索新的推理能力 [S1.p2]。对于 DeepSeek-R1-Zero，使用基于规则的奖励，包括准确性奖励和格式奖励，格式奖励要求模型将推理过程置于 <think> 和 </think> 标签内 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p3]。为解决 R1-Zero 的可读性和语言混杂问题，DeepSeek-R1 采用多阶段训练框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework.
The reward signal is solely based on the correctness of final predictions against ground-truth answers, without imposing constraints on the reasoning process itself.
we bypass the conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase before RL training.
For DeepSeek-R1-Zero, we employ rule-based rewards to deliver precise feedback for data in mathematical, coding, and logical reasoning domains.
the model is incentivized to encapsulate its reasoning process within designated tags, specifically ‘ <think> ’ and ‘ </think> ’.
we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning

experiments.text: 论文在数学、编程、STEM 等可验证任务上评估模型，使用 AIME 2024 等基准 [S2.SS3.p2]。DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的 pass@1 从 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，自洽解码后达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。DeepSeek-R1 在多个基准上评估，包括 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、GPQA Diamond、IF-Eval、AlpacaEval 2.0、ArenaHard 等 [S4.p2][S4.p3]。此外，在 AIME 2025 上 DeepSeek-R1 达到 75% 的解决率，在 AMC 12 2024 上得分 143.7/150 [A5.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%.
by leveraging the self-consistency decoding, the model’s performance can be further improved, achieving an accuracy of 86.7%.
Table 3 summarizes the performance of DeepSeek-R1 across multiple developmental stages
with AlpacaEval 2.0 improving by 25% and ArenaHard by 17%.
DeepSeek-R1 achieves a 75% solve rate (Pass@1), approaching o1’s performance of 80%.
the model attains a score of 143.7/150 in AMC 12 2024

findings.text: 纯强化学习能够激励大语言模型涌现出高级推理模式，如自我反思、验证和动态策略适应 [abstract]。DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上 pass@1 从 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，自洽解码后达 86.7%，显著超越人类参赛者平均水平 [S2.SS3.p2]。训练过程中，模型响应长度稳步增加，并出现“顿悟时刻”，表现为反思中“wait”一词使用频率的突然增加 [S2.SS3.p4][S2.SS3.p5]。DeepSeek-R1 在多阶段训练后，在推理和通用基准上均取得提升，最终在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上提升 25%，ArenaHard 提升 17% [S4.p3]。

evidence.quote: The proposed RL framework facilitates the emergent development of advanced reasoning patterns, such as self-reflection, verification, and dynamic strategy adaptation.
the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%.
by leveraging the self-consistency decoding, the model’s performance can be further improved, achieving an accuracy of 86.7%.
This performance significantly surpasses the average performance across all human competitors.
DeepSeek-R1-Zero exhibits a steady increase in thinking time throughout training, driven solely by intrinsic adaptation rather than external modifications.
DeepSeek-R1-Zero exhibits an “aha moment” (Table 2), characterized by a sudden increase in the use of the word “wait” during reflections
with AlpacaEval 2.0 improving by 25% and ArenaHard by 17%.

limitations.text: DeepSeek-R1 在结构化输出和工具使用方面能力不足，无法利用搜索引擎或计算器等工具 [S6.p3]。在 token 效率上仍有优化空间，对简单问题存在过度思考现象 [S6.p4]。语言混杂问题依然存在，模型主要针对中英文优化，处理其他语言时可能混用英语 [S6.p5]。模型对提示敏感，少样本提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]。在软件工程任务上，由于评估时间长影响 RL 效率，大规模 RL 未广泛应用，DeepSeek-R1 未展现出比 DeepSeek-V3 的巨大提升 [S6.p7]。纯 RL 方法本身面临奖励攻击挑战，对于无法通过可靠奖励模型评估的复杂任务，扩展纯 RL 仍是开放问题 [S6.p9]。

evidence.quote: Currently, the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models.
DeepSeek-R1 cannot leverage tools, such as search engines and calculators, to improve the performance of output.
there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed in response to simpler questions.
DeepSeek-R1 is currently optimized for Chinese and English, which may result in language mixing issues when handling queries in other languages.
When evaluating DeepSeek-R1, we observe that it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance.
large-scale RL has not been applied extensively in software engineering tasks. As a result, DeepSeek-R1 has not demonstrated a huge improvement over DeepSeek-V3 on software engineering benchmarks.
for complex tasks that cannot be effectively evaluated by a reliable reward model, scaling up pure RL methods remains an open challenge.
